overview_description.description:
42 is an end-to-end data omnichannel analytics and reporting platform built for the retail industry. Our retail experts consolidate raw sources of data (point-of-sale, eCommerce sources, ERPs, wholesale reports, etc.). With 42, executives, merchandisers, buyers, and sellers get clear insights on how to grow their business by harnessing the power of big data with over 100 custom-built retail metrics. 

Since being founded in 2013, our team has tailored custom solutions for all sizes of brands and retailers regardless of channel-mix and existing data sources.

42 has won and been nominated for several awards (LVMH Innovation Award, Innovation Award at the Canadian Fashion Designers Awards, Forbes 30 Under 30) and is backed by Y Combinator.

Visit us at www.42technologies.com to get started.
